title: Regelsuche
description: Regelsuche is an experimental mathematics and symbolic discovery platform for rewrite search, equality saturation, hypothesis mining, counterexample search, proof workflows, and reproducible mathematical exploration. It treats mathematical expressions as positions in a rule-based transformation game, applies parametrized transformation patterns over mathematical syntax trees, and records search paths as replayable discovery evidence.
notes: The Zenodo archive captures a release of the source code, citation metadata, software metadata, documentation, and reproducible discovery evidence generated by the project.
